item.title: FAQ (Uni:Note)
item.description:
Introduction

Uni:Note helps you organize handwritten notes and PDFs on iPad and review them using recordings, sticky markers and study tools.

Which devices and OS versions are supported?

Requires an iPad running iPadOS 17.0 or later.

Write with Apple Pencil, or enable Draw with Finger to write with one finger. Scroll with two fingers when it is on and one finger when it is off. No separate app account is required. Japanese, English, Korean, German, Traditional Chinese and French are supported.

item.title: FAQ (Smokeless)
item.description:
Introduction

What kind of app is Smokeless?

It is an app for quickly recording Smoked and Avoided and reviewing counts and money values later. It can be used both as support for quitting smoking and as a simple log tool.

What does Avoided record?

It records a time when you wanted to smoke but did not. It does not automatically count smoke-free time.

Is this a medical app?

No. It does not provide medical treatment or medical services.

item.title: FAQ (Uni:Note Pocket)
item.description:
Introduction

Uni:Note Pocket is an iPhone reader for backups created in Uni:Note.

Which devices and OS versions are supported?

Requires an iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later.

Pocket is an iPhone reader requiring a backup created in Uni:Note on iPad. It cannot create a new note by itself. No separate app account is required.

Create, edit, delete and reorder notes, pages, folders or question sets on iPad.
